parameters.componentSubtitle: Pill-tabbed programs showcase container — drop unlimited Program Tab components into the slot.

description.component: A nav-pills tab list floats over the top of the active tab's image on lg+ screens (stacked above it on smaller screens) while each tab pane swaps a full-width image for a content card inset at its bottom-right corner. Add one or more "Program Tab" components into the slot — unlimited, drag & drop reorder.

tabs_id.name: Tabs ID
tabs_id.description: Change this if more than one Programs component is placed on the same page.
